generations.prompt: Native 512x384 pixel-art dungeon battle backdrop, front elevation with shallow visible floor. Recreate the supplied composition faithfully with clean deliberate one-pixel clusters at the requested native resolution, suitable behind compact 64x64 characters. EXACT horizontal bands: y0-255 dressed back wall, y256-319 broad walkable stone platform/ledge, y320-383 quiet dark repeatable foundation. Eight 64px columns. Central tall stone arch with horned skull keystone, paired square supports with small skull reliefs, recessed iron barred grille and brass locks, hanging chains; matching plum/gold banners and paired compact wall torches; heavy outer pillars near x32 and x480; crates/skull/bone at far left foot, barrel/pot/rocks far right. Rich layered stone construction as reference, keep all motifs. Quiet combat standing areas and low-contrast center behind fighters. Charcoal muted cool violet/plum masonry, near-black recesses, restrained brown wood, dull iron, tiny brass and orange fire accents. Discrete top-left plane highlights and local warm-lit stone clusters around torches. Hard pixels, limited coherent material ramps, broad connected clusters, crisp edges, no gradients/antialiasing/blur/bloom/dithering/random speckles. Opaque background. generations.prompt: Create a coherent reusable dungeon TILE LIBRARY. Every tile is a full opaque native 64x64 SQUARE rectangle, no perspective diamond or tile slab, no spacing/outline frame. Front-facing flat wall textures and shallow side-view platform strips as specified below. All use hard one-pixel edges, large connected color clusters, restrained top-left light, NO antialias, gradients, dithering, random speckles. Palette: near-black #090618 #161227 #1f1934; cool violet stone #26203f #312c4d #42395c #544766, sparse #6f5a77; warm stone #504153 #5f4a52 #6b5056. Keep low contrast behind bright 64x64 characters. 1). cool violet brick back-wall variant A, staggered large rectangular stones, mortar courses every16px, seamlessly repeatable horizontally and vertically. 2). matching cool wall B, same edges, subtle broad wear. 3). matching cool wall C, same edges, one quiet crack. 4). matching cool wall D, same edges, slightly irregular broad stone planes. 5). platform floor A, TOP48 pixels walkable plane of shallow receding violet flagstones, BOTTOM16 pixels vertical ledge face, horizontal neighbor edges align, no vertical repeating intended. 6). floor B same exact plane/ledge boundaries with different restrained slab wear. 7). floor C same boundaries. 8). floor D same boundaries. 9). very dark quiet foundation A, chunky rectangular masonry seamless both axes, no bright details. 10). foundation B same edges. 11). foundation C same edges. 12). warm-lit wall A, same geometry/edges as cool wall, local muted brown stone-plane accents only, no flame or halo. 13). warm-lit wall B same. 14). cool wall A alternate. 15). floor alternate same48/16 boundary. 16). quiet foundation alternate. No props, torches, banners, arch, text, characters, or interface. Transparent pixels not permitted in these opaque terrain tiles.
